text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; given your history of bone fragility and delayed menarche, have you ever been told you have blue or translucent skin, or that you suffer from chronic joint pain and short stature? REQUEST TEST: Thyroid_Stimulating_Hormone, Calcium, Phosphorus, Alkaline_Phosphatase.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your normal thyroid and calcium/phosphorus levels, have you noticed a specific buildup of calcium around your joints or eyes, often described as calciphylaxis or "blue sclerae"? REQUEST TEST: 24-hour Urine Calcium, Serum Protein Electrophoresis. REQUEST IMAGES: X_Ray_of_Knees_and_Eyes.

text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteogenesis Imperfecta with associated primary ovarian insufficiency.
